title: Policy Term, Quote Validity and Notice Periods — Manufactured Home Insurance Quick Reference
content:
Every Manufactured Home Insurance policy form — the Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value, the Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost, the Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value, the Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost, the Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost and the Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost — runs on the same term and the same periods.

| Period | Length on every form | What it measures |
|---|---|---|
| Policy term | 12 months | Length of each policy term |
| Quote validity | 30 calendar days | Days a quote may be bound at its quoted premium |
| Nonpayment grace | 10 calendar days | Days after an installment due date before the notice of cancellation for nonpayment is mailed |
| Nonpayment notice | 10 calendar days | Days between mailing the notice of cancellation for nonpayment and the cancellation date |
| Reinstatement window | 15 calendar days | Days after a nonpayment cancellation within which the policy may be reinstated by paying all past-due premium |
| Renewal offer lead time | 45 calendar days | Days before expiration on which the renewal offer is issued |
| Non-renewal notice | 45 calendar days | Fewest days of notice before expiration when the carrier will not renew |

All periods other than the policy term are counted in calendar days.

## Dates read off the table (hypothetical policy)

For a hypothetical policy whose term expires on 30 September:

- the renewal offer is issued 45 days before expiration, on 16 August;
- a carrier notice that it will not renew gives at least 45 days of notice when it is mailed on or before 16 August.

## Quick answers

- How long does a quote stay bindable at its quoted premium? 30 calendar days.
- How many days of notice separate the mailing of a nonpayment notice from the cancellation date? 10 calendar days.
- How long is the window to reinstate after a cancellation for nonpayment? 15 calendar days.
